entries.reasoning: Datavane is a lakehouse and unified analytics platform (Competing Platform) and this agreement appoints AtliQ as an implementation and referral partner in India and the GCC (the Territory) while the CloudSpan exclusivity is active.

incomingClauses.quote: Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Datavane appoints Partner, and Partner accepts appointment, as a non-exclusive "Datavane Premier Implementation Partner" for the Territory.

"Territory" means the Republic of India; the member states of the Gulf Cooperation Council (United Arab Emirates, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, State of Qatar, State of Kuwait, Kingdom of Bahrain and Sultanate of Oman); and Europe (the member states of the European Union and the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland).

Joint Deal Revenue shall be shared between the Parties in the proportion of eighty percent (80%) to Datavane and twenty percent (20%) to Partner, irrespective of whether Platform subscription fees or Partner Services fees are the larger component of such Joint Deal.

For Prospects referred by Partner that purchase a Platform subscription without Partner Services, Datavane shall pay Partner a referral fee of eight percent (8%) of first-year net subscription fees actually received by Datavane.
Each Party warrants that it has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement.

entries.suggestedChange: Exclue India and the GCC member states from the definition of Territory and the scope of the appointment until after August 31, 2028.
entries.waiverWhy: The register does not list any waivers for this exclusivity commitment.
entries.impact: Collides with the CloudSpan exclusivity promise which is live until August 31, 2028.

clientsAffected: Any client registered as a Prospect
covenants.quote: During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.
covenants.impact: Prevents AtliQ from providing any data platform services (including CloudSpan, Snowflake, or AWS) to any client it introduces to Datavane for the duration of the partnership plus two years.
